questions.question: How did Israel capture Jericho?
options: By storming the gates in a frontal assault
By marching around it for seven days and shouting
By starving the city through a long siege
By digging a secret tunnel beneath the wall
questions.answer: By marching around it for seven days and shouting

questions.question: What happened to the walls of Jericho?
Only Rahab and her family were spared in Jericho.
